name: Dance of the Gibbous Moon
descriptionTemplate: Karen gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: After Karen plays a card, restore [Heal:Arg2] HP and Gain [Energy:Arg3] Aliemus. After playing {Marvelous Cuisine}, inflict [{Poison}:Arg4] {plural:[{Poison}:Arg4]|stack|stacks} of {Poison} on all enemies.
lore:
She dances beneath the crescent moon.
Her skirt swirls around her arms, like a spinning cloud.
Below her, the endlessly flowing lake merges with the sky.
Dance. Dance. A voice whispers in the dark.
Awaken the sleeping one and fulfill the millennia-old promise.
